title: The Number Pattern Hiding in Nature
description: An introduction to the Fibonacci sequence — how it's built, and why it shows up in flowers and seashells.
narration_lines: This famous number pattern shows up all over nature.
Each number is just the sum of the two before it. 3 plus 5 is 8.
Keep going the same way. 5 plus 8 is 13.
The pattern continues forever, and it's found in flower petals and seashells.

steps.label: Each number is the sum of the two before it
